resources.string: Get your TV ready to share
Let’s set up the permissions AirRelay needs. Each step explains what you are allowing, and you can skip any optional permission.
AirRelay uses the local network to appear on your iPhone, iPad and Mac and receive video and audio. Your TV can use Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
Android grants these network permissions automatically. No access to your camera, microphone or photo library is requested.
Notifications show the connection status while the receiver is ready in the background and let you stop casting.
Without this permission, the receiver still works, but its status notification is hidden.
Open the screen when casting starts
To open AirRelay and show the pairing code when a device connects from the TV home screen, allow “Display over other apps”.
Find AirRelay in the TV settings and allow access. Then press Back to return here.
Without this permission, open AirRelay yourself before connecting.
Choose your preferences. Change permissions and startup options later in Settings.

Android automatically grants the system permissions needed to run the receiver in the background, start after boot and keep the screen awake during a connection. Control these features in Startup and Connection settings.
This TV could not open the permission screen. Check TV Settings → Apps → AirRelay.
